# Meridian Marine Co. — Vendor Directory Structure v1

## Purpose

Define the minimum data MMC needs to operate a useful vendor network.

## Vendor profile

- Business name
- Primary contact
- Phone
- Email
- Service categories
- Geographic coverage
- Normal availability
- Emergency availability
- Qualification status
- Preferred/backup status
- Credentials/evidence references
- Insurance status where applicable
- Pricing/quote notes
- Restrictions
- Performance rating
- Last review date
- Internal MMC notes

## Vendor relationship history

Track:

- Assignments
- Quotes
- Approvals
- Scheduled work
- Completion confirmations
- Invoice records
- Performance reviews
- Client feedback
- Incidents/disputes

## Search requirements

The future MMC application should allow operators to filter vendors by:

- Category
- Status
- Preferred/backup
- Geography
- Emergency availability
- Performance level
- Current workload where known

## Directory principle

The directory is an operational tool, not a public endorsement list. Vendor information should be controlled and visible only to authorized MMC personnel who need it.
